deffilemode(mode):
"""Convertafile'smodetoastringoftheform'-rwxrwxrwx'."""
perm=[]
fortablein_filemode_table:

ifmode&bit==bit:
perm.append(char)
break
else:
perm.append("-")
return"".join(perm)
